verdict.rationale: Sentry's alerts docs state that an alert can send notifications, create tickets, call webhooks, or use other integrations when issues match rules. That webhook action is the hook for driving external remediation or agents. Separately, Seer Autofix automatically scans incoming issues, finds root causes and can open fix PRs, and Sentry Agent can be assigned to Linear issues. The evidence is a single high-level mention of webhook actions, with no detail. Missing for 10: webhook payload and schema documentation, signing/authentication of webhook calls, examples of wiring alert webhooks to agents or remediation runners, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
